strategy_definitions.free: train-only univariate target correlation ranking across all features
strategy_definitions.representative: training-only |rho| >= .85 graph connected components; first best target-correlated feature per component

cautions: Geographic nested validation, NOT untouched future-year temporal validation.
Connected components may chain variables that are not directly correlated.
Representative screening prohibits backup variables in same family; a later conditional re-search is needed.
Prior year/fold evaluations have been inspected repeatedly.
Fixed Ridge alpha=10; family construction and ranking occur only in current training fold.
